extension.summary: Um screensaver idêntico ao screensaver original chromecast
Un protector de pantalla tipo Chromecast para Kodi
Un économiseur d'écran comme Chromecast pour Kodi
extension.description: Display beautiful pictures originally from the chromecast screensaver. You can also display your own photos along with its respective information.
Apresenta imagens lindíssimas originalmente pertencentes ao screensaver do chromecast. Pode também apresentar as suas próprias imagens conjuntamente com a respectiva informação.
Muestra bellas imágenes como las del protector de pantalla de chromecast. También puede mostrar sus propias fotos junto con su respectiva información.
Toon prachtige afbeeldingen afkomstig van de Chromecast screensaver. Je kunt ook je eigen foto's tonen met al hun informatie.
Affichez de jolies images provenant de l’écran de veille de Chromecast. Vous pouvez aussi afficher vos propres images avec leurs informations respectives.
extension.news: v1.4.0 (20/11/2026) [fix] update to Kodi 19 xbmcvfs.translatePath change [fix] use the standard Kodi 1px hard black text shadow for the clock and picture info to improve contrast [new] show the photographer name embedded in local images (EXIF Artist, IPTC By-line or XMP creator) [fix] better handling of network failures for single image downloads or a complete disconnect [fix] respond quickly to screensaver deactivation instead of looking stuck until the next image [fix] prevent stack overflow in mode 1 with missing local picture folder [feature] consolidate pictures URLs: HQ mode was removed as all images are of equal quality; removed known-not-working URLs and added some more verified URLs to the offline list; added loading an online list that would hopefully make new Chromecast ambient mode pictures available over time.
